```yaml
name: Codex Review Notify Code Owner

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  notify-code-owner:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: useblacksmith/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: '16'
          always-auth: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run TypeScript configuration future audit
        run: bun run tsconfig:future-audit

      - name: Check for PR title containing "docs(ts)"
        id: check-pr-title
        run: echo "::set-output name=contains_docs_ts::$(echo ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }} | grep -q "docs\(ts\)" && echo "true" || echo "false")"

      - name: Notify code owner if PR title contains "docs(ts)"
        if: ${{ steps.check-pr-title.outputs.contains_docs_ts == 'true' }}
        run: |
          CODE_OWNER=$(git log -1 --pretty=%ae)
          echo "Notifying code owner: $CODE_OWNER"
          # Add notification logic here, e.g., using GitHub API or email
```

This GitHub Actions workflow will trigger when a pull request is opened or updated on the `main` branch. It checks if the PR title contains "docs(ts)". If it does, it retrieves the code owner's email address from the last commit and notifies them. You can customize the notification logic as needed, such as using the GitHub API or sending an email.
